flow.name: mcp-session-init-flow
flow.doc:name: MCP Session Init Flow
flow.doc:description: Handles incoming MCP initialize requests; logs new session details

mcp:on-new-session-listener.doc:name: MCP New Session Listener
mcp:on-new-session-listener.doc:description: Fires when an MCP client connects and sends the initialize request

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] MCP session initialized - client: ' ++ ((attributes.clientName default 'unknown') ++ ' v' ++ (attributes.clientVersion default 'unknown'))]
logger.doc:name: Log Session Init
logger.doc:description: Logs the new MCP session with client name, version, and correlation ID
